subject: 30 tickets left to StanCon 2017! New sponsor!

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: 30 tickets left to StanCon 2017! New sponsor!
parts:
Hi all,

We just sold our 150th ticket. We have 30 left. If you're thinking about coming to StanCon, buy your ticket soon: https://stancon2017.eventbrite.com

The Q&A panel at StanCon will be:
  • Andrew Gelman. Stan super user.
  • Bob Carpenter. Stan language.
  • Michael Betancourt. Stan algorithms, Math.
  • Daniel Lee. Math, CmdStan, how everything fits together.
  • Ben Goodrich. RStan.
  • Jonah Gabry. ShinyStan and everything downstream of RStan.
  • Allen Riddell. PyStan.
Stan's really a group effort and there are more developers that will be attending StanCon. For the full team, see: http://mc-stan.org/team/


Sponsors

We added a new sponsor! Here are the sponsors in order of supporting StanCon:
  • Stan Group Inc. http://stan.fit
  • Columbia University Data Science Institute. http://datascience.columbia.edu
  • Metrum Research Group. http://metrumrng.com
  • Real Capital Analytics. http://realcapitalanalytics.com
  • Facebook Research. http://research.fb.com

Live Stream

We're going to live stream StanCon 2017. I'll post more details later this week. I'm still working out technical details. We are running the live stream ourselves, so I'm sure we'll have technical difficulties. I'd really suggest attending if you are able.


Social Media

If you want to keep up, add @mcmc_stan on twitter or search for #stancon2017.
